name: Wichita Falls
summary: Wichita Falls is a city of about 102,000 in North Texas, 15 miles south of the Oklahoma line and about two hours northwest of Dallas-Fort Worth. It is an Air Force and college town with a hot, dry summer and flat, open roads. Cyclists know it as home of the Hotter'N Hell Hundred, held downtown the last Saturday of August since 1982.
about: Wichita Falls sits on the Wichita River in Wichita County, about 115 miles northwest of Fort Worth and 140 miles southwest of Oklahoma City. The city grew on oil and refining. Today its biggest employers are Sheppard Air Force Base, which trains pilots and shares its runways with the civilian airport, and Midwestern State University.

The falls in the name were washed out in a 19th-century flood. The city built a 54-foot replacement in Lucy Park in 1987. Downtown has a compact grid of old brick buildings around 8th Street and Ohio Avenue, with the MPEC convention center and Kay Yeager Coliseum on the north edge where the Hotter'N Hell weekend is based.

The climate is humid subtropical with very hot summers. In 2011 Wichita Falls became the first Texas city to record 100 days at or above 100 degrees in a single year. The city runs a tourism office under the name Discover Wichita Falls.
riding: Riding here means flat to gently rolling paved roads across open farm and ranch land, with wind and heat as the main variables. The Hotter'N Hell routes use wide highways and county roads north and west of town toward Sheppard Air Force Base and Burkburnett. Off-road riders use the Wee-Chi-Tah singletrack, which the tourism office calls the best urban off-road trail in Texas; it hosts the HHH mountain bike races each August.

For an easy spin, the city's Circle Trail is more than 20 miles of 10-foot-wide concrete path along the Wichita River and Holliday Creek, planned to reach about 24 miles when the loop closes. The August mean high is 96.6 F, so ride early.
getting_there: Most riders drive. From Dallas-Fort Worth it is about 122 miles and a little over two hours up US 287 from DFW airport; from Oklahoma City about 140 miles. Wichita Falls Regional Airport (SPS) is six miles north of town and has American Eagle flights to DFW only. You will want a car; the HHH start, expo hotels and restaurants are spread across downtown and the Kemp Boulevard corridor to the south.

hotels.name: Delta Hotels by Marriott Wichita Falls Convention Center
hotels.note: Attached to the MPEC, where HHH packet pickup and the expo happen; 200 rooms, steakhouse on site, walk to the start

hotels.name: Courtyard by Marriott Wichita Falls
hotels.note: Indoor pool and on-site dining; a short drive south of downtown near the Kemp Boulevard restaurants

hotels.name: Hampton Inn at Sikes Senter Mall
hotels.note: Free hot breakfast, indoor pool; near the mall and the Bike Stop on the south side

hotels.name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Wichita Falls
hotels.note: All suites with kitchens and free breakfast; sits on Sikes Lake with a one-mile path out the door

hotels.name: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Wichita Falls
hotels.note: Free breakfast and outdoor pool on the southwest side; a drive from the start, often cheaper on HHH weekend

hotels.name: Best Western Plus University Inn & Suites
hotels.note: Budget-friendly with free breakfast, near Midwestern State and McBride's Steakhouse

restaurants.name: Branding Iron
restaurants.address: 104 E Scott Ave, Wichita Falls, TX 76301
restaurants.note: Home-style barbecue plates a block from the HHH start line; the site has fed people since 1939

restaurants.name: 8th Street Coffee House
restaurants.note: Downtown breakfast and coffee stop, open 7:30 am weekdays; closes at 2 pm

restaurants.name: Half Pint Taproom & Restoration Hall
restaurants.note: Downtown taproom with pizza and a live-music hall; evenings only, closed Sunday

restaurants.name: Wellborn 2R Steakhouse
restaurants.note: Inside the Delta hotel at the MPEC; serves dinner nightly and a weekend brunch from 6:30 am, handy on ride morning

restaurants.name: McBride's Steakhouse
restaurants.note: Family-run since 1992, south side near the Kemp Boulevard hotels

restaurants.name: Pelican's
restaurants.note: Independent, family-owned for more than 20 years; the sit-down dinner spot on the south side

bike_shops.name: The Bike Stop
bike_shops.address: 2708 Southwest Pkwy, Suite 138, Wichita Falls, TX 76308
bike_shops.note: The city's independent shop since 1983; Trek, Giant and Liv dealer with full service and bike fitting. No rentals listed

bike_shops.name: CycleRun (Endurance House Wichita Falls)
bike_shops.note: Bike and run shop with in-house mechanics; tune-ups from $59.99, bike shipping and assembly, open Sundays 1-5 pm. No rentals listed
